name: Zoomlion
summary: Zoomlion is a Changsha industrial equipment company whose subsidiary Zhongke Yungu develops embodied intelligence and industrial robotic systems. Its robot portfolio includes Z01 bipedal humanoids, Z03 wheeled humanoids, quadrupeds and joint modules. The group uses manufacturing operations as development and demonstration environments for robot perception, motion control and industrial work skills.
